sn48.48:1.2: “Bhikkhus, how many faculties must a bhikkhu develop and cultivate so that they can declare enlightenment:
sn48.48:1.3: ‘I understand: “Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place”’?”
sn48.48:2.1: “Our teachings are rooted in the Buddha. …”
sn48.48:2.2: “A bhikkhu must develop and cultivate five faculties so that they can declare enlightenment.
sn48.48:2.5: The faculties of faith, energy, mindfulness, concentration, and wisdom.
sn48.48:2.6: These are the five faculties that a bhikkhu must develop and cultivate so that they can declare enlightenment:
sn48.48:2.7: ‘I understand: “Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place”’.”
